summary: Bug Fix Verification - KB Editor theme styling and performance optimization. Both bugs are FIXED. 1) Cards now properly adapt to light/dark theme with correct backgrounds, borders, and text colors. 2) Admin articles list endpoint excludes content_markdown for performance, individual article endpoint returns full content for lazy loading.
context_for_next_testing_agent: KB Editor theme fixes verified. Dark mode: cards use bg-[#1a1a1a], white text. Light mode: cards use bg-gray-50, dark text. Card edit popup uses bg-[#1e1e1e] (dark) / bg-white (light). Lazy loading confirmed - articles list excludes content_markdown, individual article GET returns full content. Auth: session_token=test_kb_session_token cookie.
